stem.text: Coherent waves are produced at P and at Q and travel outwards in all directions. The line RS is half-way between P and Q and perpendicular to the line joining P and Q. The distance RS is much greater than the distance PQ.

stem.alt: Diagram with points P and Q above a dashed line RS that runs down from R to S, and a dashed line XY running horizontally through S, with X on the left and Y on the right. The note NOT TO SCALE is printed at the upper right.

stem.text: Along which of the lines shown is an interference pattern observed?
